public.exams.sort_date.reason: make_date smallint arguments widen to integer; ELSE NULL has inferred date type. Same branches/default.

expected.default: CASE WHEN exam_date IS NOT NULL THEN exam_date WHEN year IS NOT NULL AND exam_month IS NOT NULL THEN pg_catalog.make_date(year, exam_month, 1) WHEN year IS NOT NULL THEN pg_catalog.make_date(year, 1, 1) ELSE NULL END

actual.default:
CASE
    WHEN (exam_date IS NOT NULL) THEN exam_date
    WHEN ((year IS NOT NULL) AND (exam_month IS NOT NULL)) THEN make_date((year)::integer, (exam_month)::integer, 1)
    WHEN (year IS NOT NULL) THEN make_date((year)::integer, 1, 1)
    ELSE NULL::date
END
actual.name: sort_date
